mapper.sql: id, user_id, type_id, title, description, images, price, duration, location, view_count, like_count, collect_count, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (user_id, type_id, title, description, images, price, duration, location, view_count, like_count, collect_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{typeId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{images}, #{price}, #{duration}, #{location}, 0, 0, 0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE status = 1 AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill WHERE status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill SET like_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill SET collect_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY (like_count + collect_count + view_count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM skill WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
